name: The Nash-bargaining proof writes the transfer as P (the stock price), the fallback as z (the noise) and the winning value as V, although eq. (14) already names the transfer T_eta
location: main.md:899-906 (A.38 and surrounding text, App. A.6); online_appendix.md:484-491 (OA.42); main.md:363 (eq. 14)
problem: P is the market maker's price P(X) throughout, but the bargaining proof uses P for the negotiated transfer, so the transfer has two symbols (T_eta and P). evidence: main.md:902 "$\max_{P\in[z,V]}(P-z)^\eta(V-P)^{1-\eta}$"; main.md:906 "giving $P=z+\eta(V-z)=(1-\eta)z+\eta V$"; main.md:363 "$T_\eta(R,\theta)=(1-\eta)\min\{R,\theta\}+\eta\max\{R,\theta\}$"; main.md:68-69 "$X=q+Z$, $f(z)=\frac{1}{2b}e^{-|z|/b}$"
proposed_fix: Write the Nash problem in model primitives. Replace (A.38) and (OA.42) with $\max_{t\in[\min\{R,v_\theta\},\,\max\{R,v_\theta\}]}(t-\min\{R,v_\theta\})^\eta(\max\{R,v_\theta\}-t)^{1-\eta}$. final_fix: Replace (A.38) and (OA.42) with $\max_{t\in[\min\{R,v_\theta\},\,\max\{R,v_\theta\}]}(t-\min\{R,v_\theta\})^\eta(\max\{R,v_\theta\}-t)^{1-\eta}$.
